summary: Iteration 11 - frontend-only Playwright verification on mobile viewport (390x844) against preview https://wide-doc-signing.preview.emergentagent.com with LIVE backend https://utility-contract-hub.emergent.host. ALL 8 review-request flows PASS. (1) Sign-in with test creds -> lands on /dashboard, all 5 bottom tabs render (Home, Sites, Reports, Support, Profile). (2) Typography consistency verified programmatically: Sites 'Your sites' title = 18px, Reports 'Your spend' title = 18px (IDENTICAL); Sites subtitle '0 sites' = 13px rgb(100,116,139), Reports subtitle 'Annual estimate...' = 13px rgb(100,116,139) (IDENTICAL muted style). Empty states: Sites 'No sites yet' icon-tile = 64x64, Reports 'No data yet' icon-tile = 64x64 (IDENTICAL); Sites empty title = 18px, Reports empty title = 18px (IDENTICAL). Back chevron rendered by ScreenHeader on all tab screens (header-back-button testID). (3) Reports tab: title 'Your spend' present, subtitle 'Annual estimate based on your current tariffs and usage.' present, empty state 'No data yet' visible with reports-scan-button 'Scan a bill to get started' visible (test account has no spend data, expected). (4) Profile tab: all 6 rows render (Email alerts, Phone push notifications, My sites, My quote requests, Replay product tour, Contact support). (5) Support tab: dark banner 'Hi e2e_test_1786703401, we've got you.' + 'How our team can help' list render correctly. (6) Landing (/landing): landing-title = 'Never overpay on utilities again.', trust strip visible, all 4 features rendered, both CTA buttons (landing-create-account, landing-signin) visible. (7) 'Create free account' navigates to /splash and all 3 slides render in order ('Snap a bill' -> 'Find better rates' -> 'Stay ahead of renewals') via splash-next; splash-skip visible. Only pre-existing web-only warnings (shadow* props, pointerEvents) unchanged from prior iterations.
